single_line_comment.comment: Accept timeout and client disconnect - continue processing.
Server was interrupted.  This only happens when stopping.

cont_single_line_comment.comment: Run the preServe event to indicate server is now listening and that it is safe to connect.
Dereference any resources from any previous client creation such that a blocking accept does not hold them indefinitely.
If we have reached the limit on the number of concurrent clients allowed, wait for one or more clients to drain before accepting another.
All other transport exceptions are logged. State of connection is unknown.  Done.
Order is important because serve() releases serverTransport_ when it is interrupted, which closes the socket that interruptChildren uses.
